name: Jev: ask several questions per message, batched

parameters.jsCode:
const messages = [
  'Cancel my subscription right now, this is unacceptable.',
  'Can I get a copy of last month\'s invoice?',
  'Login page shows a 500 error since this morning.',
  'Thanks for the quick fix yesterday!',
  'How do I add a second user to my account?',
  'I want my money back, the product never arrived.',
  'Is there an API for exporting reports?',
  'The mobile app logs me out every few minutes.',
  'Please update my billing address to our new office.',
  'Your support team was rude and unhelpful.'
];
return messages.map((text, i) => ({ json: { id: i + 1, text } }));
